question: How can I get luckier?
short_answer: In the teaching, luck is aliveness — a vitality you tune into by lining up your attention with it, relaxing open, and letting tension sink back into the earth. The more refined the connection gets, the more volume luck has in your life.
answer_markdown:
lucky is an aliveness. a vitality that activates the functions of the body. in a crude analogy its a bit like a radio. until you plug it in and it has some juice its inactive. then its a matter of tuning in the station. the station is the quality of spirit you live in. the attitude and the energy you carry. and then you turn up the volume so it can be heard. how do you do that. you line up your attention with the vitality. the more you do the more refined the connection gets. you relax and open. the tension sinks back into the earth and you get more grounded. and with that the aliveness grows. that is the volume it has in your life. so how lucky do you want to be.

joy is the greatest treasure. don't get mad. don't even get even. create a beautiful world
